observations: Predicted one of seven road closures disconnects the six-town graph.
Closed and reopened each of all seven roads independently: only 3–4 reduced reachability to three of six; the other six retained all towns.
Restored all roads and ran Walk depth-first. The graph labeled visit order and earliest reachable ancestor, with dotted back roads.
Reveal accurately summarized seven tests, six redundant roads and the unique bridge 3–4, then linked the low-link labels to the absence of a bypass.

complexity.reason: Connectivity is intuitive; interpreting low-link order adds conceptual work.
complexity.interfaceBurden: Seven toggles and one traversal control; vertical scrolling.

whyCool: A complete set of road experiments leads directly into how an efficient bridge-finding algorithm works.
caveat: One fixed undirected graph; no second case to apply the algorithm.
effort: Completed prediction, seven independent closures, traversal, screenshots and reveal.
bucketReason: Exceptional controlled interaction and visual explanation on the tested graph.

interaction.evidence: Seven independent closures and reopening; depth-first traversal.
